title: Starry GUI/Hotbar Extra Additions
description: adds support for several small mods to my other pack Starry GUI!
body:
**main pack!! you will need this: [Starry GUI and Hotbar](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/starry-gui-and-hotbar)**

versions 1.20.1 and 1.21.11 were selected due to perceived popularity from the main pack, more will be added in the future if requested. 

since some mods change texture formatting between the two versions, these two pack versions may not work for all respective surrounding game versions. **PLEASE let me know if errors are found.**

-----------------

the long-awaited "i'll do this someday!" pack extends the main pack's theme to:

    appleskin
    JEI
    jade
    sophisticated backpacks + storage

tested using the forge versions of the mods. i am assuming any fabric version's textures are formatted the same.

----------------
How to download:

    Click 'download texture pack'.
    Go to your download folder, and copy/cut the zip.
    Locate your .minecraft resource pack folder, and paste it in.
    Reload your Minecraft resource packs, and you'll be able to use it!

-> Please put this pack above all others in your resource pack menu, or else it will not work. If you need help, DM aelianix on discord or find me elsewhere at https://aelianix.carrd.co! <-
